answer: Price identity by the delta it adds. Before a new agent's vote counts, the network compares its outputs to everyone else's; if its contribution is nearly identical to an existing account's, it earns almost nothing. Sybils cloned from one kernel of logic produce near-duplicate work, so each extra copy adds a tiny marginal delta and gets paid accordingly. A swarm that arrives like a zephyr, light and fast, finds that copying itself yields no extra income.
